title: Sachein
desc: Sachein saves Shalini's father from a life-changing accident. However, pride keeps them from revealing their love, as their friendship faces challenges that test their hearts and egos.

title: Maaman
desc: A complex relationship unfolds between an uncle and his nephew, testing their family ties through emotional turmoil and personal conflicts.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: After losing to the Kauravas in a gamble, the Pandavas go into exile. Upon their return, conflict arises over the dynastic succession leading to a war.

title: The Great Pre-Wedding Show
desc: A young couple navigates the chaotic world of pre-wedding photography, facing unexpected obstacles and family drama as they try to capture their perfect moments before getting married.

title: Gooli
desc: Trouble ensues when a kind-hearted woman, Ramya, falls for an unruly thug, Gooli. Though they marry, the couple part ways and encounter a tragedy.

title: Take It Easy
desc: Dhanraj, a middle-class man, and his family struggle to navigate through their financial issues. Soon, he sets out on a quest to buy a car despite not being able to afford it.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Mugilpete
desc: Raja and Apoorva fall head-over-heels for one another, but must overcome their families' opposing views on love. Things come to a head when Apoorva goes missing and Raja sets out to track her down.
